items.conditions: VESA Adaptive-Sync Display CTS r1.1 (19 May 2023): AdaptiveSync Display logo tier requires an Adaptive-Sync maximum refresh rate ≥ 144 Hz (MediaSync: ≥ 60 Hz) and minimum ≤ 60 Hz, at factory default resolution.
items.locator: Table 2-1 'Mandates that Vary by Logo Performance Tier', p.21
items.confidenceNotes: Threshold for certification, not a display measurement.

items.labelEn: VESA AdaptiveSync Display240 tier refresh rate
items.labelFr: Palier AdaptiveSync Display240 de VESA (fréquence de rafraîchissement)
items.conditions: Logo tier designator = maximum video frame rate achievable with Adaptive-Sync at factory default resolution; Display240 given as example tier.
items.locator: Section 2.4 'VESA CERTIFIED Compliance Program', p.24; Table 2-1 note a
items.quote: such as AdaptiveSync Display144 or Display240
items.confidenceNotes: 240 is an example designator; tiers are the tested maximum, not a fixed list.

items.labelEn: Frame time at 144 Hz
items.labelFr: Durée d'une image à 144 Hz
items.conditions: One refresh period at exactly 144 Hz (VESA AdaptiveSync minimum maximum rate).

items.labelEn: Frame time at 240 Hz
items.labelFr: Durée d'une image à 240 Hz
items.conditions: One refresh period at exactly 240 Hz.
items.quote: such as AdaptiveSync Display144 or Display240

items.labelEn: VESA AdaptiveSync Display maximum average grey-to-grey response time
items.labelFr: Temps de réponse gris à gris moyen maximal exigé par VESA AdaptiveSync Display
items.conditions: Average over 64 G2G transitions from a 9 x 9 matrix with factory-default overdrive; AdaptiveSync tier only.
items.confidenceNotes: Certification upper bound, not a measurement.

items.labelEn: HDMI 2.1 maximum bandwidth (Ultra High Speed HDMI Cable)
items.labelFr: Bande passante maximale de HDMI 2.1 (câble Ultra High Speed HDMI)
items.conditions: Ultra High Speed HDMI Cable, introduced with HDMI 2.1 (market entry 2020), for system configurations up to 48 Gbps; gross link rate (FRL). HDMI 2.2 raises this to 96 Gbps (already in corpus).
items.locator: Ultra High Speed HDMI Cable paragraph
items.quote: It is applicable for system configurations supporting up to 48Gbps maximum bandwidth.
items.confidenceNotes: The page is now the HDMI 2.2 overview; the sentence describes the 48G cable class of HDMI 2.1.
